blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hyperspectral remote sensing provides dense spectral measurements that are indispensable for material-level Earth observation, yet the construction of a general-purpose hyperspectral foundation model remains difficult. Two bottlenecks are especially limiting. First, large hyperspectral corpora rarely provide high spatial resolution together with reliable dense annotations. Second, many hyperspectral models are still trained almost from scratch, so the geometric and interactive priors learned by modern vision foundation models are not fully reused. To alleviate these issues, we present HyperSAM , a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that couples a data-centric hyperspectral synthesis pipeline with a spectral adaptation architecture based on Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). On the data side, HyperSAM synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution SpaceNet multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer generator, while SAM3-derived pseudo-masks provide object-centric supervision. On the model side, the latest implementation uses a frozen SAM3 RGB image branch, a trainable hyperspectral side encoder initialized from the RGB vision transformer (ViT), ControlNet-style zero-initialized feature injection, and a lightweight mixture-of-experts mask refiner. To enhance training robustness against noisy pseudo-labels, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS)-style confidence selection is incorporated for noisy-label weighting. Extensive experiments show that HyperSAM obtains strong generalization on diverse hyperspectral tasks (e.g., classification, anomaly detection, change detection, target detection, and airborne oil-spill mapping) and that high-quality synthetic hyperspectral data can be more effective than simply scaling noisy hyperspectral supervision.
blocks.zh: 超光谱遥感提供密集的光谱测量,对材料一级的地球观测是必不可少的,然而,建立通用的超光谱基础模型仍然很困难。 两个瓶颈尤其有限。 首先,大型超光谱公司很少提供高空间分辨率和可靠的密集说明。 其次,许多超光谱模型几乎还是从零开始训练,因此现代视觉基础模型所学的几何学和交互前科并没有完全再利用. 为了缓解这些问题,我们提出了HyperSAM,一种快速的超光谱基础模型,该模型将一个以数据为中心的超光谱合成管道与基于Section Anything Model 3(SAM3)的光谱适应结构结合起来。 在数据方面,HyperSAM通过物理学知情的丰度转移发生器,合成来自高分辨率SpaceNet多谱图像的全谱超光谱立方体,而SAM3衍生的伪质量提供以物体为中心的监督. 在模型方面,最新的实施使用一个冷冻的SAM3 RGB图像分支,一个从RGB视觉变压器(ViT)初始化的可列车超光谱侧编码器,ControlNet风格的零初始特性注射,以及轻量级的混合专家面具精密器. 为提高培训力度,防止噪音伪标签,采用了跨模式样本选择(CromSS)式的信心选择,用于噪音标签加权。 广泛的实验表明,HyperSAM在多样的超光谱任务(如分类,异常探测,变化探测,目标探测,以及空中溢油绘图)上获得了强烈的概括性,高质量的合成超光谱数据可以比简单的缩放高频谱监督更有效.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Hyperspectral imagery (HSI) records hundreds of contiguous spectral bands for every spatial location. Compared with RGB or conventional multispectral imagery, the resulting data cube preserves fine absorption and reflection patterns that reveal material composition, vegetation status, mineral signatures, man-made objects, and subtle surface changes. These properties make hyperspectral analysis central to land-cover classification, anomaly discovery, target detection, crop monitoring, mineral exploration, urban interpretation, and disaster assessment [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . However, hyperspectral remote sensing also creates a difficult learning problem: the data are high dimensional, sensor-dependent, costly to annotate, and often acquired at modest spatial resolution. A model that performs well on one scene or task can easily fail when the wavelength range, ground sampling distance, object scale, or annotation protocol changes [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 超光谱图像(HSI)记录了每个空间位置的数百个毗连光谱带. 与RGB或常规多光谱图像相比,由此产生的数据立方体保留了细小的吸收和反射模式,揭示了物质组成,植被状况,矿物特征,人造物体,以及微妙的表面变化. 这些特性使超光谱分析成为土地覆盖分类、异常发现、目标探测、作物监测、矿物勘探、城市解释和灾害评估[1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8]的核心。 然而,超光谱遥感也造成了一个困难的学习问题:数据是高维度的,依赖传感器的,对注释成本很高,并且常常以微小的空间分辨率获得. 当波长范围、地面取样距离、物体尺度或注释协议发生变化时,在一个场景或任务上表现良好的模型很容易失效。

blocks.en: Foundation models have changed the way many visual recognition problems are solved. Instead of training a task-specific model from a small labeled dataset, a general model is first trained on a broad corpus and then adapted or prompted for downstream use. In remote sensing, recent work has explored large-scale pretraining for multispectral and hyperspectral data, including SatMAE, SpectralGPT, DOFA, HyperSIGMA, and HyperFree [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 6 , 7 ] . These models demonstrate that pretraining can improve transferability, but the hyperspectral setting still lags behind the rapid progress of natural-image foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM), SAM2, and SAM3 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . The gap is not only architectural. It is also caused by the absence of a hyperspectral counterpart to the massive, diverse, and accurately annotated data used to train generic segmentation models.
blocks.zh: 基础模型改变了许多视觉识别问题的解决方式. 一个通用模型不是从一个贴有标签的小型数据集培训一个特定任务的模型,而是首先培训一个广泛的实体,然后加以调整或促使下游使用。 在遥感方面,最近的工作探索了多光谱和超光谱数据的大规模预训,包括SatMAE、SpectralGPT、DOFA、HyperSIGMA和HyperFree[10、11、12、6、7]。 这些模型表明,预训可以提高可转移性,但超光谱设定仍然落后于自然图像基础模型的快速进展,例如分层任意模型(SAM),SAM2和SAM3[13,14,15]. 差距不仅是建筑。 造成这种情况的另一个原因是,用于培训通用分区模型的大规模、多样性和准确附加说明的数据缺乏超光谱对应数据。

blocks.en: From the perspective of downstream use, remote-sensing foundation models follow two distinct paradigms. Representation-learning models such as SatMAE, SpectralGPT, DOFA, HyperSIGMA, and SpectralEarth, as well as generic self-supervised models such as DINOv3, transfer a pretrained encoder but generally require a task-specific head, linear probe, or fine-tuning procedure for a new scene or task [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 6 , 16 , 17 ] . Promptable models instead expose a prompt-to-mask interface and can reuse a frozen checkpoint without retraining the backbone. HyperFree is the closest prior promptable hyperspectral model, whereas HyperSAM targets the same tuning-free setting while preserving a frozen SAM3 spatial prior and injecting full-spectrum hyperspectral evidence [ 7 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 从下游使用的角度来看,遥感基础模型遵循两个截然不同的模式。 SatMAE,SpectralGPT,DOFA,HyperSIGMA,SpectralEarth等代表学习模型,以及DINov3等通用自控模型转移一个事先训练过的编码器,但一般需要针对特定任务头,线性探测器,或者对新场景或任务进行微调的程序[10,11,12,6,16,17]. 相反,快速模型暴露出一个即时对任务接口,可以重新使用一个冻结的检查站,而不对主干进行再培训。 超时 Free是最接近的先前可快速的超光谱模型,而HyperSAM的目标是相同的无调速设置,同时保留一个冻结的SAM3空间在前和注射的全光谱证据[7,15].

blocks.en: We identify two bottlenecks that typically appear when building hyperspectral foundation models:
blocks.zh: 我们发现在建立超光谱基础模型时通常会出现的两个瓶颈:

blocks.en: Data quality bottleneck. Classical hyperspectral benchmarks, such as Indian Pines and Pavia University (PaviaU), are valuable because they contain clean annotations and well-studied protocols [ 18 , 19 ] . Yet they are too small and homogeneous to support foundation-level learning. Larger resources, including HySpecNet-11k and HyperGlobal-style corpora, improve scale but often trade away either spatial detail or object-level labels [ 20 , 21 , 6 ] . HyperFree makes a notable step toward promptable hyperspectral foundation modeling by constructing the Hyper-Seg corpus [ 7 ] . Its data engine generates pseudo-masks by applying SAM-H to selected three-channel views of real hyperspectral images and then uses these masks to supervise promptable hyperspectral segmentation. However, many images in Hyper-Seg are broad natural landscapes, such as mountains, rivers, and vegetation, where object contours are weak and semantic boundaries are often ambiguous. Moreover, the SAM-H-generated masks inevitably contain noisy or coarse regions, while HyperFree directly uses them for training without explicitly modeling such label uncertainty. This limits the boundary quality and object-centric supervision needed for a generalizable promptable hyperspectral foundation model (HFM).
blocks.zh: 数据质量瓶颈. 古典的超光谱基准,例如印度松树和帕维亚大学(PaviaU),是有价值的,因为它们包含干净的说明和经过充分研究的协议[18,19]. 然而,它们太小,过于单一,无法支持基础一级的学习。 更大的资源,包括HySpecNet-11k和Hyper-Global风格的corpora,改进了规模,但往往交换空间细节或物体级标签[20,21,6]. HyperFree通过构建Hyper-Segeum[7],为快速超光谱基建模迈出了显著的一步. 其数据引擎通过将SAM-H应用到对真实的超光谱图像选择的三通道视图中,然后使用这些口罩来监督快速的超光谱分解,从而产生伪质量. 然而,Hyper-Seg中的许多图像都是广义的自然景观,如山脉,河流,植被等,其中物体轮廓较弱,语义界限往往模糊. 此外,SAM-H生成的口罩不可避免地含有吵闹或粗糙的区域,而HyperFree则直接用于培训,而没有明确模拟这种标签不确定性. 这限制了通用的超光谱基础模型(HFM)所需的边界质量和以物体为中心的监督.

blocks.en: Prior utilization bottleneck. Many hyperspectral models use masked image modeling or reconstruction objectives to train a new backbone on hyperspectral data [ 11 , 6 ] . This is reasonable when spectral statistics differ from those of RGB imagery, but it underuses the strong spatial priors already encoded in modern segmentation foundation models. SAM-style models learn to associate points, masks, boundaries, objectness, and multi-scale geometry through large visual corpora [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . These priors are highly relevant to hyperspectral remote sensing because many downstream tasks are not purely spectral. They require the model to propose coherent fields, rooftops, vehicles, roads, rivers, shorelines, changed parcels, or target-like regions. The key question is therefore not whether RGB priors should be reused, but how to inject spectral evidence without destroying them.
blocks.zh: 预先使用瓶颈。 许多超光谱模型使用蒙面图像模型或重建目标,在超光谱数据上训练新的骨干[11,6]. 当光谱统计与RGB图像不同时,这是合理的,但它没有充分利用现代分块基础模型中已经编码的强烈空间前兆。 SAM风格的模型通过大型视觉蝎子[13,14,15]学习准点,口罩,边界,对象,以及多尺度几何. 这些前科与超光谱遥感高度相关,因为许多下游任务并非纯光谱. 它们要求模型提出连贯的田地、屋顶、车辆、道路、河流、海岸线、变更的地块或类似目标的区域。 因此,关键问题不是RGB前身是否应当重新使用,而是如何在不销毁的情况下注入光谱证据.

blocks.en: To alleviate these issues, this paper proposes HyperSAM , a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that jointly addresses data quality, prior utilization, and noise-robust supervision. HyperSAM constructs an object-centric hyperspectral training corpus by synthesizing full-spectrum HSI from high-resolution multispectral SpaceNet imagery and pairing the reconstructed cubes with SAM3-derived pseudo-masks, thereby providing sharper spatial details and more reliable object-level supervision than existing hyperspectral foundation-model training corpora. It further adapts the SAM3 backbone to hyperspectral remote sensing through a prior-preserving dual-branch architecture, where a frozen RGB branch retains strong geometric and prompt-response priors while a trainable spectral branch injects full-spectrum corrections through zero-initialized residual adapters. A lightweight mixture-of-experts (MoE) decoder is introduced to refine task-agnostic mask predictions under diverse object scales and residual label uncertainty. To enhance robustness against imperfect pseudo-masks, HyperSAM further incorporates a noisy-label learning strategy inspired by Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS) [ 22 ] , which was originally proposed to mitigate noisy supervision in multimodal remote sensing segmentation by using cross-modal confidence masks to identify reliable training signals. In our setting, the RGB-prior branch and the hyperspectral branch provide complementary confidence cues for pseudo-mask supervision: high-confidence regions are emphasized, uncertain regions are softly down-weighted rather than treated as equally reliable, and class-balanced confidence selection is used to prevent dominant categories or easy regions from overwhelming the training process. This confidence-aware weighting is combined with hyperspectral-specific spatial and spectral augmentations, improving invariance to geometric perturbations, spectral response variations, and band-wise degradation. With these designs, HyperSAM provides a unified prompt-mask-feature interface for hyperspectral classification, anomaly detection, change detection, and target detection, achieving strong cross-task generalization as shown in Fig. 1 . Fig. 2 summarizes the resulting difference between HyperSAM and representative hyperspectral foundation-model paradigms.
blocks.zh: 为缓解这些问题,本文建议采用HyperSAM,一种快速的超光谱基础模型,共同处理数据质量、事先使用和噪音扰动监督问题。 HyperSAM通过从高分辨率多光谱空间网图像合成全光谱HSI,将重建的立方体与SAM3衍生的伪面团配对,构建了以物体为中心的超光谱训练仪,从而比现有的超光谱基础模型训练公司提供更清晰的空间细节和更可靠的物体级监督. 它进一步通过预先保留的双分支架构使SAM3主干线适应超光谱遥感,其中冷冻的RGB分支保留了强几何和即时反应的前身,而可训练的光谱分支通过零初始化的剩余适配器注入全谱校正. 采用了一种轻量级专家混合物(MoE)解码器,以完善不同对象尺度和剩余标签不确定性下的任务不可知面罩预测. 为了增强抵御不完善的伪质量的强性,HyperSAM进一步采用了由跨模式样本选择(CromSS)[22]启发的噪声标签学习策略,最初建议通过使用跨模式信任口罩识别可靠的培训信号来缓解在多式联运分化中的噪声监督. 在我们的环境下,RGB-先导分支和超光谱分支为假面具监督提供了互补的置信提示:高自信区域被强调,不确定区域被软降加权而不是作为同等可靠的对待,阶级平衡的置信选择被用来防止主导类别或容易区域压倒训练过程. 这种具有信心的权重结合了超光谱特异性空间和光谱增强,改善了对几何扰动的变异性,光谱响应变异,以及波段降解. 通过这些设计,HyperSAM为超光谱分类,异常检测,变化检测,以及目标检测提供了统一的即时任务特性界面,实现了图1所示的强跨任务概括化. blocks.en: The contributions of this work are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献概述如下。

blocks.en: • We introduce a data-centric paradigm for hyperspectral foundation modeling by synthesizing full-spectrum hyperspectral data from semantically rich multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer mechanism. The resulting corpus provides sharp spatial details, diverse object semantics, and well-aligned spectral-mask supervision. • We develop HyperSAM , a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that adapts the SAM3 backbone through a dual-branch spectral feature injection scheme and a lightweight mixture-of-experts decoder. This design transfers strong generic visual priors into the hyperspectral domain while preserving sensitivity to full-spectrum material information. • We formulate pseudo-mask supervision as a common robust-learning problem in hyperspectral foundation modeling. A confidence-aware training strategy uses agreement across spectral views and branches to softly reweight unreliable regions and improve stability under noisy pseudo-labels. • We demonstrate the cross-task effectiveness of HyperSAM on multiple hyperspectral remote sensing tasks, including hyperspectral classification, anomaly detection, change detection, and target detection. Under the common small-scene protocols, the experiments show strong transfer with a single frozen checkpoint and validate the unified prompt-mask-feature inference paradigm.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Remote Sensing and Hyperspectral Foundation Models
blocks.zh: II-A 遥感和超光谱基础模型

blocks.en:
Recent remote sensing foundation models have moved from task-specific learning toward reusable representations across sensors, scenes, and downstream tasks.
SpectralGPT explores spectral remote sensing pretraining with a 3D generative transformer and demonstrates transferability across scene classification, semantic segmentation, and change detection [ 11 ] .
SkySense extends this trend to multimodal and multitemporal remote sensing by jointly modeling optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations with large-scale spatiotemporal pretraining [ 23 ] , while DOFA introduces a wavelength-conditioned dynamic framework to handle heterogeneous Earth observation sensors [ 12 ] .
For hyperspectral imagery, HyperSIGMA builds a billion-scale HSI foundation model trained on HyperGlobal-450K and shows strong cross-task representational ability [ 6 ] .
SpectralEarth further highlights the importance of large-scale and globally distributed Environmental Mapping and Analysis Program (EnMAP) data for hyperspectral foundation-model training [ 16 ] .
Generic self-supervised models such as DINOv3 follow a similar feature-centric downstream paradigm, although they are pretrained on different data and are not specifically designed for hyperspectral imagery [ 17 ] . These methods primarily follow a representation-learning paradigm: their pretrained encoders are transferred through task-specific heads, linear probing, or downstream fine-tuning. Promptable models instead expose point-, box-, mask-, or concept-driven interfaces and can generate masks or transferable features without updating the backbone at inference time. More recently, HyperFree addresses channel-adaptive and tuning-free hyperspectral interpretation through prompt engineering and a learned wavelength dictionary [ 7 ] . It is therefore the closest prior promptable HSI method to HyperSAM.

最近的遥感基础模型已经从特定任务的学习转向传感器、场景和下游任务的可重复使用的表示。

对于超光谱成像,HyperSIGMA构建了一个在HyperGlobal-450K上训练的十亿级HSI基础模型,并显示出强大的跨任务代表能力[6].
光谱地球进一步突出了大规模和全球分布的环境测绘和分析方案数据对于超光谱基础模型培训的重要性[16]。
DINOv3等通用的自我监督模型遵循类似的以地物为中心的下游范式,虽然它们预先在不同的数据上训练,并且不是专门为超光谱图像设计[17]. 这些方法主要遵循一种表现学习的范式:其经过预先训练的编码器通过任务特定头,线性探测,或下游微调进行传输. 可启动的模型反而暴露出点,盒,面具,或概念驱动的接口,可以在推论时间不更新主干线的情况下生成口罩或可转移特性. 最近,HyperFree通过即时工程和学会的波长词典,地址为频道适应和调频无超光谱解释[7]. 因此,这是最接近HyperSAM的事先快速HSI方法.

blocks.en: The two promptable approaches nevertheless differ in data, supervision, and spectral adaptation. HyperFree is trained on real Hyper-Seg images using SAM-H-derived pseudo-masks as direct supervision. HyperSAM constructs physically constrained full-spectrum synthetic cubes from high-spatial-resolution SpaceNet imagery, preserves a frozen SAM3 RGB branch, injects material-sensitive features through a trainable hyperspectral side encoder with zero-initialized adapters, refines masks through a scale-adaptive MoE path, and treats SAM3-derived pseudo-masks as noisy supervision through confidence-aware reweighting. HyperSAM therefore targets object-centric promptable learning with high spatial fidelity while retaining the original prompt-response prior.
blocks.zh: 然而,两种迅速的办法在数据、监督和光谱适应方面有所不同。 超时 Free在真实的Hyper-Seg图像上接受培训,使用SAM-H派生的伪面团作为直接监督. HyperSAM从高空间分辨率SpaceNet图像中构造物理受限的全谱合成立方体,保留一个冷冻的SAM3 RGB分支,通过可训练的超光谱侧编码器注入材料敏感特性,零初始化适配器,通过比例适应的MOE路径精细化口罩,并通过信心感知的再加权处理SAM3衍生的伪质量作为噪音监督. 因此,HyperSAM以高度空间忠诚的以物体为中心的快速学习为目标,同时保留最初的即时反应。

blocks.en: II-B Promptable Segmentation for Remote Sensing
blocks.zh: II-B 遥感快速分解

blocks.en:
Promptable segmentation models provide a flexible interface for generating masks from points, boxes, masks, or semantic prompts.
SAM introduced general promptable segmentation, while SAM3 further extends the paradigm to concept-level prompting by detecting, segmenting, and tracking all instances matching a given concept [ 13 , 15 ] .
In remote sensing, RSPrompter learns prompts for SAM-based instance segmentation [ 24 ] , PointSAM adapts SAM with point-level supervision and pseudo-label refinement [ 25 ] , and AnyChange exploits SAM latent matching for zero-shot remote sensing change detection [ 26 ] .
RemoteSAM further formulates Earth observation understanding as a referring-segmentation-centered framework for unifying pixel-, region-, and image-level tasks [ 27 ] .
These methods demonstrate the value of promptable segmentation priors in remote sensing, but they are mainly designed for RGB or multispectral imagery.
HyperSAM differs by preserving the geometric and prompt-response priors of SAM3 while injecting full-spectrum hyperspectral information through a trainable spectral branch.
blocks.zh:
快速分解模型为从点,盒,口罩或语义提示中生成口罩提供了灵活的接口.
SAM引入了一般可迅速分解,而SAM3则通过检测,分解,跟踪所有符合特定概念的实例[13,15],将范式进一步扩展到概念层面的提示.
在遥感方面,RSPrompter学习了SAM基于实例分解的提示[24],PointSAM通过点级监督和伪标签的完善来改造SAM[25],AnyChange利用SAM潜在匹配进行零射遥感变化探测[26].
远程遥感卫星进一步制定地球观测理解,作为统一像素、区域和图像一级任务的参考部分中心框架[27]。
这些方法证明了快速分解前兆在遥感中的价值,但它们主要是为RGB或多光谱图像设计的.
HyperSAM通过保存SAM3的几何学和即时反应前科,同时通过可训练光谱分支注入全谱超光谱信息而有所不同.

blocks.en: II-C Synthetic Hyperspectral Data and Noisy-Label Learning
blocks.zh: II-C 合成超光谱数据和噪音标签学习

blocks.en: Large-scale dense annotation remains a major obstacle for hyperspectral foundation-model training. Physics-informed reconstruction methods synthesize hyperspectral data from multispectral observations by estimating material abundances and transferring them through spectral endmember libraries [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] . HyperSAM follows this physically constrained direction, but uses it for foundation-model data construction: pseudo-masks are obtained from high-resolution visible imagery, while full-spectrum cubes are reconstructed from aligned multispectral observations. Because generated masks remain imperfect, robust learning from noisy pseudo-labels is also required. Co-teaching, confident learning, and broad noisy-label studies show that treating all labels as equally reliable can cause confirmation bias and degraded generalization [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] . In multimodal remote sensing, Cross-modal Sample Selection uses cross-modal confidence and entropy cues to select reliable noisy supervision [ 22 ] . HyperSAM adapts this general principle to promptable hyperspectral training by using spectral-view and branch-level agreement to construct soft, class-balanced confidence weights.
blocks.zh: 大规模密集注解仍然是超光谱基础模型培训的一个主要障碍。 物理知情重建方法通过估计材料丰度并通过光谱端成员库转移,合成多光谱观测的超光谱数据[28,29,30]. HyperSAM遵循这个物理受限的方向,但用于基础模型数据构建: 伪质量从高分辨率可见图像中获取,而全光谱立方体则通过对齐的多光谱观测重建. 由于生成的口罩仍然不完善,还需要从吵闹的假标签中进行有力的学习. 共同教学、自信学习和广泛的吵闹标签研究表明,将所有标签视为同样可靠的标签会导致确认偏差和退化的泛化[31、32、33]。 在多模式遥感中,跨模式样本选择使用跨模式置信度和py提示来选择可靠的噪音监督[22]. HyperSAM通过使用光谱视图和分支级协议来构建软的,类平衡的置信权重,使这个一般原则适应快速的超光谱训练.

blocks.en: III Method Overview
blocks.zh: 三. 方法概述

blocks.en:
HyperSAM is built around three coupled components: high-quality hyperspectral dataset construction, a SAM3-based promptable model framework, and a robust learning strategy for noisy pseudo-mask supervision.
The dataset construction component synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution multispectral SpaceNet imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer mechanism and pairs them with SAM3-derived object masks from the corresponding RGB images.
The model framework adapts SAM3 to hyperspectral imagery by preserving the frozen RGB prior branch while using a trainable spectral branch to inject full-spectrum information through zero-initialized residual adapters [ 34 ] . A lightweight MoE decoder further refines mask predictions across different object scales and scene structures [ 35 , 36 ] .
The robust learning component handles imperfect pseudo-masks through hyperspectral-specific augmentations and confidence-aware noisy-label weighting inspired by Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS) [ 22 ] , emphasizing reliable regions while softly down-weighting uncertain ones.
Finally, HyperSAM predicts task-agnostic masks, mask quality scores, and transferable feature representations that support downstream hyperspectral interpretation. Details are provided in the following subsections.
blocks.zh:
HyperSAM是围绕三个组合组件构建的:高质量超光谱数据集构建,基于SAM3的快速模型框架,以及响亮的伪面具监督的强健学习策略.
数据集构建组件通过物理知情丰度-传输机制,从高分辨率多光谱空间网图像中合成全光谱超光谱立方体,并配以相应的RGB图像中SAM3衍生对象口罩.
模型框架通过保留冷冻的RGB前分支,同时使用可训练光谱分支通过零初始化的剩余适配器注入全谱信息,使SAM3适应超光谱图像[34]. 轻量级的MOE解码器进一步完善了不同物体尺度和场景结构的遮罩预测[35,36].
强健的学习部分通过超光谱特异性增强和信心感噪声标签权重处理不完善的伪质量,受到跨模式样本选择(CromSS)[22]的启发,强调可靠的区域,同时轻轻减重的不确定区域.
最后,HyperSAM预测任务不可知面罩,遮盖质量分数,以及支持下游超光谱解释的可转移特征表示. 详情见以下各分节。

blocks.en: III-A High-Fidelity Hyperspectral Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: III-A 高纯度超光谱 数据集建设

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Visual comparison of training data. HyperFree samples are often limited by coarse spatial details or weaker object boundaries, whereas the HyperSAM synthetic training data contain sharper outlines, richer object categories, and pseudo-masks suitable for promptable foundation-model training.

blocks.en:
The first component constructs an object-centric hyperspectral training corpus from high-resolution multispectral imagery.
We use SpaceNet 2 imagery [ 37 ] , which provides aligned RGB images and 8-band WorldView-3 multispectral observations over four geographically distinct urban regions: Las Vegas, Paris, Shanghai, and Khartoum. One synthetic hyperspectral cube and its corresponding pseudo-label set are generated from each retained aligned RGB–multispectral patch. The resulting corpus contains 10,592 training patches and 3,527 validation patches, providing variation in urban morphology, surface materials, vegetation, and environmental conditions.
This choice is motivated by two complementary advantages.
First, the RGB images contain sharp spatial structures and rich urban objects, allowing SAM3 to generate more reliable object-level pseudo-masks than those obtained from low-resolution or weakly structured hyperspectral scenes.
Second, the multispectral observations preserve physically meaningful spectral responses of the same surface materials, making them suitable for constrained hyperspectral reconstruction rather than purely appearance-based synthesis.
As shown in Fig. 3 , the resulting training samples contain clearer object boundaries and richer semantic entities than existing pseudo-labeled hyperspectral corpora.
blocks.zh:
第一个组件从高分辨率多光谱图像中构建一个以物体为中心的超光谱训练装置。
我们使用SpaceNet 2图像[37],该图像提供一致的RGB图像和8波段的WorldView-3多光谱观测,覆盖四个地理上不同的城市地区:拉斯维加斯、巴黎、上海和喀土穆。 从每个保留对齐的RGB-多光谱补丁中产生一个合成的超光谱立方体及其相应的伪标签集. 由此产生的教程包含10,592个训练补丁和3,527个验证补丁,在城市形态、表面材料、植被和环境条件方面提供了差异。
这一选择有两个互补优势。
首先,RGB图像包含尖锐的空间结构和丰富的城市物体,使得SAM3能够产生比从低分辨率或结构薄弱的超光谱场景中获得的更可靠的物体级伪质量.
第二,多光谱观测保留同一表面材料的物理上有意义的光谱反应,使其适合受限的超光谱重建,而不是纯粹的外观合成.
如图3所示,由此产生的训练样本包含比现有伪标签的超光谱公司更清晰的物体界限和更丰富的语义实体。

blocks.en: In our construction, semantic annotation and spectral reconstruction are decoupled by assigning distinct roles to different spectral bands of the input data. Object masks are extracted from the visible (RGB) bands of the high-resolution multispectral images, where promptable segmentation models perform reliably. Concurrently, the full sets of multispectral channels are converted into hyperspectral cubes through a physics-informed abundance-transfer process. This design avoids applying segmentation models directly to non-visible spectral subsets with ambiguous object boundaries, effectively preserving high-quality spatial supervision while enriching each pixel with full-spectrum material information.
blocks.zh: 在我们的建筑中,语义注释和光谱重建通过给输入数据的不同光谱带分配不同的作用而脱钩。 从高分辨率多光谱图像的可见(RGB)波段中提取物体遮罩,可快速分解模型在那里可靠地发挥作用. 同时,多光谱通道的整组通过物理学知情的丰度转移过程转化为超光谱立方体. 这种设计避免了将分区模型直接应用到对象界限模糊的不可见光谱子集,有效地维护了高质量的空间监督,同时用全谱材料信息丰富每个像素.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Physics-informed hyperspectral reconstruction pipeline. Multispectral SpaceNet imagery is decomposed into abundance and illumination maps, which are transferred through a hyperspectral endmember library to synthesize full-spectrum cubes aligned with object-level pseudo-masks.
blocks.zh: 图4:物理信息超光谱重建管道. 多光谱 SpaceNet图像被分解成丰度和照明图,这些图通过一个超光谱端成员库传输,以合成与物体级伪面团一致的全光谱立方体.

blocks.en:
The reconstruction module follows the physics-informed hyperspectral synthesis principle of Physics-informed Deep Adversarial Spectral Synthesis (PDASS) [ 29 ] . The overall reconstruction process is illustrated in Fig. 4 .
Rather than regressing hyperspectral bands independently, we assume that both multispectral and hyperspectral observations of the same scene can be explained by shared material abundances under different sensor response functions.
This assumption is consistent with the linear spectral mixing model widely used in hyperspectral analysis: a pixel spectrum is represented as a mixture of several material endmembers modulated by illumination.
Therefore, once the material abundance and illumination of each pixel are estimated from the multispectral image, the same physical composition can be transferred to a hyperspectral endmember library to synthesize a full-spectrum cube.
The source endmember spectra are obtained from the public USGS Spectral Library Version 7 data release [ 30 ] . Following the physics-informed selection strategy of PDASS [ 29 ] , we retain artificial materials, coatings, liquids, minerals, organic compounds, soils and mixtures, and vegetation. A spectrum is retained only when a matched, complete record exists in both the WorldView-3-resampled and Airborne Visible/Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS)-2014-convolved releases and every reflectance value lies in [ 0 , 1.5 ] [0,1.5] . Uniform subsampling by a factor of two yields E = 772 E=772 paired materials. We use these sensor-specific releases directly and match their records by material identifier, producing A ms ∈ ℝ 8 × E A_{\mathrm{ms}}\in\mathbb{R}^{8\times E} and A hsi ∈ ℝ 224 × E A_{\mathrm{hsi}}\in\mathbb{R}^{224\times E} whose corresponding columns describe the same material. The AVIRIS library covers approximately 400–2500 nm.

blocks.en: Both the pseudo-mask generator and the frozen RGB-prior branch use Meta’s original November 2025 SAM3 image release [ 15 ] , implemented with the official codebase 1 1 1 https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam3 and the released facebook/sam3 sam3.pt checkpoint 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/facebook/sam3 . blocks.en: III-B HyperSAM Model Architecture
blocks.zh: III-B 超声波 模型建筑

blocks.en: HyperSAM adapts SAM3 to hyperspectral imagery by preserving its promptable segmentation priors while adding a lightweight spectral adaptation pathway. HyperSAM retains the pretrained SAM3 image encoder, prompt encoder, and mask decoder with frozen parameters. Hyperspectral adaptation is achieved through a spectral-spatial patch embedding and spectral-shape extractor, a trainable side transformer, layer-wise zero-initialized residual adapters, and an MoE-based residual refiner.
blocks.zh: HyperSAM通过保留其可迅速分解的前身,同时添加轻量级光谱适应路径,使SAM3适应超光谱图像. HyperSAM保留了预先训练的SAM3图像编码器,即时编码器,以及带有冷冻参数的面具解码器. 超光谱改造是通过一个光谱-空间补丁嵌入和光谱-形状提取器、一个可训练的侧式变压器、一层零初始化的剩余适配器和一个基于MOE的剩余精炼器实现的。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 7 , the model contains four main parts: a frozen RGB prior branch, a trainable hyperspectral side branch, residual spectral injection adapters, and a prompt-driven mask decoder with MoE refinement. The RGB branch takes a three-channel proxy formed from the closest available bands to 700, 546.1, and 438.8 nm. Nearest-band selection, percentile stretching, the official SAM3 normalization, and resizing to 1008 × 1008 1008\times 1008 are applied before the proxy is passed through the frozen SAM3 image encoder. Feature level 2 is used for mask–feature matching. In parallel, the hyperspectral cube is processed by the side branch to extract full-spectrum material information that is unavailable in the RGB proxy. During training, all SAM3 image-encoder and prompt-processing parameters remain frozen, while the hyperspectral side encoder, injection adapters, and MoE refinement path are optimized.

For the hyperspectral branch, inputs from different sensors are first interpolated to a fixed spectral dimension.
A spectral-spatial patch embedding mixes local spatial context with band-wise information, while a spectral-shape extractor models the reflectance profile at each spatial location.
The resulting tokens are projected to the same dimension and spatial resolution as the SAM3 visual tokens, so that spectral evidence can be injected into the frozen RGB representation layer by layer.
The side encoder is initialized from the RGB transformer where dimensions are compatible, which provides a stable starting point for spectral adaptation.

After training, given a hyperspectral image and a prompt, HyperSAM produces three unified outputs: task-agnostic masks, mask quality scores, and dense spectral-spatial feature embeddings.
Specifically, the masks describe prompt-related candidate regions, the quality scores rank their reliability, and the dense embeddings provide material- and context-aware features for similarity matching, prototype construction, and temporal comparison.
The same prompt-mask-feature interface is then reused for hyperspectral classification, anomaly detection, change detection, and target detection.

具体地说,口罩描述的是即时相关的候选区域,质量分数排名其可靠性,密集的嵌入为相似性匹配,原型构造,以及时间比较提供了材料和上下文感的特征.

blocks.en: III-C Robust Learning With Confidence-Aware Noisy-Label Weighting
blocks.zh: III-C 自信的强健学习

blocks.en:
Although SAM3-derived masks provide stronger object boundaries than coarse hyperspectral pseudo-labels, they may still contain uncertain boundaries, incomplete objects, fragmented regions, or background leakage.
The RGB-derived masks are nevertheless treated as potentially noisy supervision rather than exact hyperspectral ground truth: visible object boundaries and material boundaries can disagree around shadows, thin structures, mixed pixels, roof–background transitions, and visually similar surfaces with different spectra. Large homogeneous object interiors are generally more reliable because the RGB image and synthesized cube share the same geometry, while confidence-aware training locally suppresses ambiguous boundaries and background leakage rather than rejecting an entire mask.
HyperSAM therefore adopts a robust learning strategy that combines hyperspectral-specific augmentations, best-mask supervision, cross-view consistency, and confidence-aware noisy-label weighting.
blocks.zh:
虽然SAM3衍生的口罩提供了比粗糙的超光谱伪标签更强的物体边界,但它们可能仍然含有不确定的边界,不完整的物体,零碎的区域,或背景泄漏.
尽管如此,RGB衍生的口罩仍被视为潜在的噪音监督,而不是精确的超光谱地面真理:可见的物体边界和物质边界可以围绕阴影、薄的结构、混合像素、屋顶-背景过渡以及视像相似的表面而存在不同的光谱。 大型同质物体内饰一般比较可靠,因为RGB图像和合成立方体具有相同的几何特征,而自信感知训练则局部压制模糊的界限和背景渗漏,而不是拒绝一个完整的面具.
因此,HyperSAM采用一种强力的学习策略,结合超光谱特异性增强,最佳任务监督,交叉视野一致性,以及信心感知噪声-标签权重.

blocks.en:
Specifically, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS) [ 22 ] selects reliable noisy supervision by comparing confidence estimates from different modalities and reducing the influence of uncertain regions.
HyperSAM extends this idea from multimodal segmentation to promptable hyperspectral learning.
Instead of relying on external modalities, it constructs two augmented spectral views from the same hyperspectral cube and uses the RGB-prior branch and hyperspectral branch as complementary confidence sources.
Regions that remain confident and consistent across views and branches receive larger weights, while ambiguous regions are softly down-weighted rather than discarded.
Class-balanced selection is further used to prevent frequent background regions or easy objects from dominating the supervision.
blocks.zh:
具体来说,跨模式样本选择(CromSS)[22]通过比较不同模式的信任估计和减少不确定区域的影响来选择可靠的吵闹监督.
HyperSAM将这一想法从多式联运分化扩展至迅速的超光谱学习.
它不依靠外部模式,而是从同一个超光谱立方体构建两个增强光谱视图,并使用RGB-先导分支和超光谱分支作为互补的置信源.
不同观点和分支之间保持信心和一致性的区域受到更大的重视,而模棱两可的区域则被轻轻地压低而不是被抛弃。
分类平衡选择被进一步用于防止频繁的背景区域或容易的物体主导监管.

blocks.en:
To build cross-view confidence, HyperSAM samples two contiguous spectral windows from the same synthetic cube. Each window length is drawn uniformly from 128 to 224 bands, and its starting position is sampled uniformly from the valid range. The selected window is then interpolated to 224 channels for the common model interface. The second view is sampled independently, redrawn if it is identical to the first, and constrained to share at least 32 bands with the first view. The minimum overlap preserves common material evidence, while the wide random windows and independent starts introduce substantial spectral-response variation. Both views retain the same spatial target, so the consistency term regularizes the model against spectral cropping rather than changing the segmentation supervision.
Let f a f_{a} and f b f_{b} be the label-class confidence maps from the two views.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en: We evaluate HyperSAM on four representative hyperspectral interpretation tasks: hyperspectral classification (HC), hyperspectral anomaly detection (HAD), hyperspectral change detection (HCD), and hyperspectral target detection (HTD). The main tables test whether the promptable spectral adaptation improves cross-task generalization under a single checkpoint, while the ablation studies isolate the data synthesis pipeline, promptable spectral branch, MoE refinement, and robust pseudo-mask weighting. Following the task-oriented organization commonly used in hyperspectral foundation-model evaluation [ 6 ] , each task first specifies the dataset, supervision, prompting rule, and decision rule, and then reports quantitative and qualitative results. All experiments use the same trained HyperSAM checkpoint. No task-specific network is trained for any downstream benchmark. The evaluation is intentionally limited to one-shot, zero-shot, or otherwise low-label small-scene settings and does not constitute a large-patch benchmark with full downstream fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们评价HyperSAM的四个具有代表性的超光谱判读任务:超光谱分类(HC),超光谱异常检测(HAD),超光谱变化检测(HCD),超光谱目标检测(HTD). 主要表格测试快速光谱适应是否在单一检查点下改进了跨任务通用性,而衰减研究则隔离了数据合成管道,快速光谱分支,MOE精细化,以及强效的伪面具权重. 按照在超光谱基础模型评价中常用的任务导向组织[6],每项任务首先规定数据集,监督,提示规则,以及决定规则,然后报告定量和定性结果. 所有实验都使用同一训练有素的HyperSAM检查站. 没有为任何下游基准培训具体任务网络。 该评价有意限于一发,零发,或者以其他方式低标签的小型场景设置,不构成具有完全下游微调的大板标基准.

blocks.en: In addition to reporting final accuracy, the experimental analysis is organized to echo the two bottlenecks identified earlier: whether high-quality spectral-mask data are more useful than merely scaling weak supervision, and whether promptable visual priors can be reused without losing hyperspectral material sensitivity. Therefore, the following analysis discusses not only which method obtains the best metric, but also why the same prompt-mask-feature interface helps or fails under different task assumptions. The ablations further separate the contributions of synthetic spectral construction, MoE mask refinement, and confidence-aware pseudo-mask weighting, so that the practical role of each component can be interpreted beyond a simple state-of-the-art comparison.
blocks.zh: 除了报告最终的准确性外,实验分析组织起来也回应了早些时候发现的两个瓶颈:高品质的光谱掩码数据是否比仅仅缩放弱监督更有用,以及快速的视觉前科是否可以在不失去超光谱材料敏感性的情况下再利用. 因此,以下分析不仅讨论了哪种方法获得最佳的度量衡,而且还讨论了同一即时-任务-特性界面为何在不同的任务假设下帮助或失败. 熔岩进一步分离了合成光谱构造,MOE面具精细化,以及信心意识伪面具权重的贡献,使得每个组件的实际作用可以被解释得超越简单的最先进的比较.

blocks.en: IV-A General Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: IV-A 一般实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets and Metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和计量

blocks.en: We report compact comparisons on two representative datasets for each task. HC is evaluated on Indian Pines [ 18 ] and Pavia University [ 19 ] , which contain 16 agricultural land-cover classes and 9 urban land-cover classes, respectively. HAD is evaluated on Beach-1 and Beach-2 from the Airport-Beach-Urban benchmark [ 38 ] . HCD is evaluated on BayArea/River and Hermiston following standard hyperspectral change-detection protocols [ 39 , 40 ] . HTD is evaluated on the Nuance Cri scene [ 41 ] and the Airport scene from the Airport-Beach-Urban benchmark [ 38 ] . For HC, we report overall accuracy (OA), average accuracy (AA), and Kappa. For HAD and HTD, we report detection factor (DF) and overall detection performance (ODP). For HCD, we report intersection-over-union (IoU) and F1 score. All reported metrics follow the higher-is-better convention.
blocks.zh: 我们报告就每项任务的两个代表性数据集进行紧凑的比较。 HC在印度松树[18]和帕维亚大学[19]上得到评价,它们分别包含16个农业土地覆盖课和9个城市土地覆盖课. 在Beach-1和Beach-2上, HCD在BayArea/River和Hermiston上根据标准的超光谱变化检测协议进行评估[39,40]. HTD在Nuance Cri场景[41]和机场场景从Airport-Beach-Urban基准[38]上评价. 就人道主义协调员而言,我们报告总体准确性(OA)、平均准确性(AA)和Kappa。 对于HAD和HTD,我们报告检测因子(DF)和总体检测性能(ODP). 对于HCD,我们报告交叉结合(IoU)和F1的分数. 所有报告的衡量标准都遵循更高水平的公约。

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate HyperSAM on the Hyperspectral Oil Spill Database (HOSD) benchmark for hyperspectral oil-spill mapping [ 42 ] . Specifically, we use the Gulf of Mexico GM13 and GM17 scenes, where AVIRIS hyperspectral cubes provide dense spectral measurements for distinguishing oil-covered water from clean or non-oil sea surfaces. Each pixel is annotated as either oil spill or clean seawater. These scenes are not used during HyperSAM training and therefore provide an additional evaluation of transferability to environmental monitoring imagery.
blocks.zh: 我们还在超光谱溢油数据库基准上评价了超光谱溢油图[42]。 具体而言,我们使用墨西哥湾GM13和GM17的场景,其中AVIRIS超光谱立方体提供了密集的光谱测量,以区分含油水与清洁或非石油海面。 每个像素被注为溢油或净海水. 这些场景在HyperSAM培训期间没有使用,因此提供了对环境监测图像的可转让性的额外评价。

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 基线

blocks.en: The comparison includes task-specific methods and recent foundation-model-style methods. For HC, the baselines are SSFTT [ 43 ] , TGRS-ViT [ 44 ] , HyperSIGMA [ 6 ] , DOFA [ 12 ] , HyperFree [ 7 ] , and SAM3 [ 15 ] . For HAD, we compare with the Reed–Xiaoli detector (RXD) [ 4 ] , Auto-AD [ 45 ] , TDD [ 46 ] , ADLR [ 47 ] , and the foundation-model baselines. For HCD, we compare with FC-EF/FC-SD [ 48 ] , ML-EDAN [ 39 ] , SST-Former [ 40 ] , and the foundation-model baselines. For HTD, the baselines include ACE [ 49 ] , the matched filter (MF) [ 5 ] , the generalized likelihood ratio test (GLRT) [ 50 ] , TSTTD [ 51 ] , and the foundation-model baselines.
blocks.zh: 比较包括具体任务的方法和最近的奠基模型式的方法. HC的基线为SSFTT [43],TGRS-ViT [44],HyperSIGMA [6],DOFA [12],HyperFree [7],以及SAM3 [15]. 对HAD来说,我们比较Reed–Xiaoli探测器(RXD)[4],Auto-AD[45],TDD[46],ADLR[47],以及基础模型基线. 对于HCD,我们比较FC-EF/FC-SD [48],ML-EDAN [39],SST-Former [40],以及基础模型基线. 对于HTD,基线包括ACE [49],匹配的滤波器(MF) [5],通用概率比测试(GLRT) [50],TSTTD [51],以及基础模型基线.

blocks.en: These baselines are deliberately grouped into classical spectral-statistical detectors, task-specific deep networks, and recent foundation-model-style methods. This grouping helps isolate whether HyperSAM benefits mainly from hyperspectral discrimination, from task-specific optimization, or from the reusable promptable representation learned by the SAM3-based architecture.
blocks.zh: 这些基线被刻意分为古典光谱统计探测器,任务特定的深层网络,以及最近的基础模型式方法. 这种组合有助于分离HyperSAM是主要受益于超光谱区分,还是从任务特定优化,还是从基于SAM3的架构学到的可重复使用的即时表示.

blocks.en: The adaptation budget is controlled explicitly. For HC, SSFTT and TGRS-ViT are trained from random initialization using only the one-shot labels. The linear-probing (LP) variants HyperSIGMA-LP and DOFA-LP keep their pretrained backbones frozen and train only a one-shot linear classifier. HyperFree and HyperSAM perform inference without target-scene parameter updates, and the SAM3 baseline uses the same three-channel proxy and prompting protocol as HyperSAM but omits the hyperspectral side encoder and MoE adaptation. All methods use the same seeded support configuration in a given comparison. For HAD, no anomaly labels, target spectra, or manual prompts are provided. For HCD, no changed-pixel labels are used. For HTD, every method receives the same prescribed target spectrum or support prompt. The HyperSIGMA-LP HC values therefore measure a one-shot frozen-backbone linear-probe setting, rather than the task-specific fine-tuning protocol and larger label budgets reported in the original HyperSIGMA study [ 6 ] . The comparison should consequently be interpreted as low-label transfer and prompt efficiency, not as a claim about the maximum performance obtainable after full downstream adaptation.
blocks.zh: 适应预算受到明确的控制。 对于HC,SSFTT和TGRS-ViT是从随机初始化开始的训练,只使用一发的标签. 线性测试(LP)变体HyperSIGMA-LP和DOFA-LP保持其预先训练的骨干冷冻,只训练一发线性分类器. HyperFree和HyperSAM在没有目标空间参数更新的情况下进行推论,SAM3基线使用与HyperSAM相同的三通道代理和提示协议,但省略了超光谱侧编码器和MOE的适应. 所有方法在给定的比较中使用相同的种子支持配置. 对HAD来说,没有提供异常标签、目标光谱或手动提示。 对于HCD,没有使用更改的像素标签. 对于HTD,每种方法都得到相同的规定的目标频谱或支持迅速. 因此,HyperSIGMA-LP HC值测量一发冷冻后骨线探测设置,而不是原始报告中针对任务的微调协议和更大的标签预算 HyperSIGMA研究 [6]. 因此,这种比较应被解释为低标签转让和迅速效率,而不是对在充分下游适应后所能达到的最大性能的主张。

Unless otherwise stated, automatic mask generation uses 32 point prompts per side, 64 points per batch, predicted-IoU threshold 0.3, stability threshold 0.4, and box nonmaximum suppression (NMS) threshold 0.7. The HAD experiments use a denser grid with 96 point prompts per side and predicted-IoU threshold 0.4 because anomalies are usually small and can be missed by sparse prompting. blocks.en: IV-B Hyperspectral Classification
blocks.zh: 四-B 超光谱 分类

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 四-B 1 实验设置

blocks.en: For HC, HyperSAM is evaluated in a one-shot-per-class setting. On Indian Pines and Pavia University, one labeled support pixel is drawn uniformly at random from each semantic class without replacement using a seeded generator, and all remaining labeled pixels are used for testing. A fixed pool of 50 support configurations is precomputed, and the same configuration is used for HyperSAM and all baselines in each comparison. The model is not fine-tuned on either dataset. HyperSAM first generates masks using the common grid protocol with 32 point prompts per side in Table I . For each support pixel, the smallest generated mask covering that pixel is selected to reduce mixed-class context. The class prototype is obtained by averaging the dense spectral-spatial embeddings inside the selected support mask. If no generated mask covers a support pixel, its single-pixel embedding is used as a deterministic fallback. All candidate masks are then assigned to the nearest class prototype by cosine similarity, and the resulting mask labels are converted into a full classification map.
blocks.zh: 对于HC,HyperSAM在每类一发的设定下进行评估. 在印度松树和帕维亚大学上,每个语义类都统一随机抽取一个标注支持像素,而不使用种子生成器进行替换,其余标注像素全部用于测试. 预先计算了一个50个支持配置的固定集合,在每次比较中HyperSAM和所有基线都使用相同的配置. 该模型在两个数据集上都没有微调. HyperSAM首先使用通用的网格协议生成口罩,表一中每侧有32点提示. 对于每个支持像素,选择覆盖该像素最小生成的面具以减少混合类上下文. 类原型是通过平均在选定的支持面具内嵌入密集的光谱空间来获得的. 如果没有生成的遮罩覆盖一个支持像素,它的单像素嵌入被作为决定性的倒置. 所有候选口罩随后通过余弦相似性被分配到最近的类原型,由此产生的口罩标签被转换成完整的分类图.

blocks.en: IV-B 2 Results and Analyses
blocks.zh: 四-B 2 结果和分析

blocks.en: As shown in Table II , HyperSAM achieves the best OA, AA, and Kappa on both Indian Pines and PaviaU among the compared methods. On Indian Pines, it improves the OA from 62.49% for SAM3 to 69.37%, showing that the spectral side branch supplies material information that cannot be recovered from RGB-style priors alone. On PaviaU, HyperSAM reaches 89.12% OA and 85.81% Kappa, outperforming HyperFree and SAM3. The comparison with SAM3 is especially informative because both models share the same promptable segmentation prior at inference time. The gain therefore comes from adapting the representation to full-spectrum HSI rather than from changing the prompting protocol. The comparison with HyperFree further indicates that channel-adaptive foundation modeling is not sufficient by itself when the downstream decision relies on object-consistent masks and local spectral separability.
blocks.zh: 如表二所示,HyperSAM在比较方法中在印度松树和PaviaU上取得了最好的OA,AA和Kappa。 在印度松属上,它将OA从62.49%的SAM3改进为69.37%,表明光谱侧分支提供的材料信息单从RGB型前科无法回收. 在PaviaU上,HyperSAM达到89.12% OA和85.81% Kappa,表现优于HyperFree和SAM3. 与SAM3的比较资料特别丰富,因为两种模型在推论时间之前都具有相同的快速分解. 因此,收益来自使表述方式适应全谱HSI,而不是改变提示协议. 与HyperFree的比较进一步表明,当下游决定依赖于与物体一致的口罩和局部光谱分离时,信道适应基建模型本身是不够的.

blocks.en: The one-shot protocol also reveals why the smallest-mask support rule is useful. A single labeled pixel may lie inside a mixed agricultural parcel or near an urban boundary. Selecting the smallest generated mask that covers the support point reduces the amount of irrelevant context used to form the class prototype, which directly matches the data-quality argument in Section III-A : object-centric masks are valuable because they turn sparse labels into region-level but still boundary-aware supervision. We further provide a qualitative comparison in Fig. 9 . Consistent with the quantitative metrics, traditional and pixel-level foundation-model baselines often suffer from salt-and-pepper noise or fragmented predictions within homogeneous regions. In contrast, HyperSAM produces highly coherent classification maps with sharp and accurate land-cover boundaries. This visual improvement highlights the complementary nature of our design: the promptable object priors provide coherent spatial support that suppresses local noise, while the full-spectrum features ensure accurate class discrimination in spectrally subtle areas.
blocks.zh: 一发协议也揭示了为什么最小的掩码支持规则是有用的. 单一标注的像素可能位于混合农业包裹内或城市边界附近. 选择覆盖支持点的最小生成的遮罩会减少用于形成类原型的不相关上下文的量,这直接符合第三节-A中的数据质量论证:以物体为中心的遮罩是有价值的,因为它们将稀疏的标签转化为区域级别但仍然具有边界意识的监督. 我们还在Fig中提供了定性比较。 9. 根据定量衡量标准,传统和像素一级的基础模型基线往往在相同区域内受到盐和上层噪音或零散预测的影响。 相比之下,HyperSAM制作的分类图高度一致,具有尖锐准确的土地覆盖边界. 这种视觉改进凸显了我们设计的互补性:即时对象前传提供了连贯的空间支持,抑制了局部噪声,而全光谱特征则确保了光谱微妙地区的准确类别区别.

blocks.en: Fig. 9: Qualitative comparison of hyperspectral classification results. Compared to the baselines, HyperSAM produces more spatially coherent classification maps with sharper land-cover boundaries and significantly less salt-and-pepper noise, demonstrating the benefit of region-level promptable priors.
blocks.zh: 费格。 9:超光谱分类结果定性比较. 与基线相比,HyperSAM制作空间更加连贯的分类图,其陆地覆盖边界更尖锐,盐和pper噪音明显减少,显示了区域一级快速前科的好处.

blocks.en: IV-C Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: IV-C 超光谱异常检测

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 实验设置

blocks.en: HAD is evaluated on Beach-1 and Beach-2 from the Airport-Beach-Urban benchmark [ 38 ] . No target spectrum, support prompt, or anomaly label is used during inference. HyperSAM generates dense mask proposals using 96 point prompts per side, 64 points per batch, predicted-IoU threshold 0.4, stability threshold 0.4, and box NMS threshold 0.7. Because the anomalies in these scenes are spatially compact, large masks are treated as background structures and suppressed. Candidate masks with relative area below the default threshold 0.0009 are retained as anomaly proposals, and their mask-level responses are projected back to the pixel grid to produce the final anomaly map.
blocks.zh: 在Beach-1和Beach-2上, 在推论过程中没有使用目标谱,支持即时,或异常标签. HyperSAM利用每边96点提示,每批64点,预测-IoU阈值0.4,稳定性阈值0.4,以及框NMS阈值0.7. 由于这些场景中的异常是空间紧凑的,因此大口罩被当作背景结构处理并被压制. 相对面积低于默认阈值0.0009的候选人口罩作为异常建议保留,他们的口罩级别响应被预测回像素网格,以产生最终的异常图.

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Results and Analyses
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 结果和分析

blocks.en: Table II shows that HyperSAM obtains the best DF on both Beach-1 and Beach-2 and the best ODP on Beach-2. On Beach-1, HyperSIGMA and DOFA obtain higher ODP because their score distributions are more aggressive around the target, but HyperSAM still gives the highest DF and cleaner object-level localization. This distinction is important: a high DF indicates that the compact abnormal object is captured by the promptable mask proposals, whereas ODP is also affected by score calibration and background ranking. HyperSAM therefore does not simply amplify all high-contrast pixels. It first searches for spatially coherent small regions and then converts them into an anomaly map.
blocks.zh: 表二显示,HyperSAM在Beach-1和Beach-2上获得最佳DF,在Beach-2上获得最佳ODP. 在Beach-1上,HyperSIGMA和DOFA获得更高的ODP,因为他们的得分分布在目标周围更为激进,但是HyperSAM仍然给予最高的DF和较清洁的对象级别本地化. 这种区别很重要:一个高的DF表示,紧凑的异常物体被迅速的面具建议所捕捉,而ODP也受到分数校准和背景排名的影响. HyperSAM因此不能简单地放大所有高孔像素. 它首先搜索空间一致的小区域,然后将它们转换成异常地图.

blocks.en: The qualitative comparisons in Fig. 10 and Fig. 11 show the same trend: classical and task-specific detectors often activate ship edges, water boundaries, or background structures, whereas HyperSAM produces compact responses around anomalous objects with fewer scattered false alarms. This behavior supports the motivation for constructing high-resolution pseudo-mask supervision. Even though HAD is unsupervised at test time, the learned ability to propose reliable small regions helps transform pixel-level spectral abnormality into object-level evidence, which is difficult to obtain from reconstruction-only foundation features.
blocks.zh: 图10和图11中的质量比较显示了同样的趋势:古典和任务特定的探测器经常激活船边,水边界,或背景结构,而HyperSAM则在异常物体周围产生紧凑的反应,散布的假警报较少. 这种行为支持构建高分辨率伪面具监督的动机. 尽管HAD在测试时不受监督,但所学的提出可靠小区域的能力有助于将像素级光谱异常转化为对象级证据,这很难从只从重建的基质特征中获得.

blocks.en: Fig. 10: Qualitative comparison on the Beach-1 anomaly detection scene from the Airport-Beach-Urban benchmark [ 38 ] . HyperSAM localizes the target with compact mask-level responses while suppressing most background structures.
blocks.zh: 费格。 10:从机场-沥青-城市基准上对Beach-1异常探测场景进行定性比较[38]. HyperSAM在压制大多数背景结构的同时,用紧凑的面具级别响应将目标本地化.

blocks.en: Fig. 11: Qualitative comparison on the Beach-2 anomaly detection scene from the Airport-Beach-Urban benchmark [ 38 ] . HyperSAM reduces false alarms from shoreline and water-background regions and highlights coherent anomalous targets.
blocks.zh: 费格。 11:Beach-2异常探测场景从机场-贝奇-城市基准[38]. HyperSAM减少来自海岸线和水底地区的虚假警报,并突出一致的异常目标。

blocks.en: IV-D Hyperspectral Change Detection
blocks.zh: 四维光谱 更改检测

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 实验设置

blocks.en: HCD is evaluated on BayArea/River and Hermiston following common hyperspectral change-detection protocols [ 39 , 40 ] . HyperSAM is used in a zero-shot setting: no changed or unchanged pixels from the target pair are used to train a classifier or tune the model. For each bi-temporal pair, masks are generated independently on the two dates using 32 point prompts per side, predicted-IoU threshold 0.3, stability threshold 0.4, and box NMS threshold 0.7. For a mask generated at one date, HyperSAM averages the dense embeddings inside the same spatial region at both dates and computes a cosine-distance change score. This produces two directional change maps, one from each temporal mask set [ 52 ] . The final score map is obtained by taking the maximum response of the two directions, and the binary change map is produced using the fixed quantile threshold 0.74.
blocks.zh: HCD在BayArea/River和Hermiston上根据常见的超光谱变化检测协议进行评估[39,40]. HyperSAM在零镜头设定中被使用:没有改变或不变的目标对像素用于训练一个分类器或调制模型. 对于每对双时针,口罩在两个日期上独立生成,使用每边32点的提示,预测-IoU阈值0.3,稳定性阈值0.4,框NMS阈值0.7. 对于在一个日期生成的面具,HyperSAM平均在同一空间区域内的密集嵌入在两个日期,并计算一个余弦-距离变化分数. 这产生了两个方向变化图,每个时间面具集各一张[52]. 最终的分数图通过取两个方向的最大响应来获得,二进制变化图则使用固定的四进制阈值0.74生成.

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Results and Analyses
blocks.zh: 四-D 2 结果和分析

blocks.en: On BayArea/River, HyperSAM is close to the task-specific FC-SD detector [ 48 ] and outperforms the other foundation-model baselines. On Hermiston, HyperSAM achieves the best IoU and F1 among all compared methods, improving IoU from 50.82% for HyperFree [ 7 ] to 70.31%. The improvement is consistent with the prior-utilization bottleneck discussed in the introduction: change detection requires not only spectral sensitivity, but also a stable spatial unit over which spectral differences can be compared. Pixel-level distances can be unstable under slight misregistration, seasonal variation, or local illumination differences, while the mask-level comparison averages features inside coherent regions and therefore reduces local noise.
blocks.zh: 在BayArea/River上,HyperSAM接近任务特定的FC-SD探测器[48],并超越其他基础模型基线. 在赫尔米斯顿上,HyperSAM在所有比较方法中都实现了最好的IoU和F1,将IoU从50.82%的HyperFree[7]提高到70.31%. 改进与导言中所讨论的先前使用的瓶颈是一致的:变化检测不仅需要光谱敏感度,还需要稳定的空间单位,可以比较光谱差异。 像素水平的距离在轻微误登记,季节性变异,或局部照明差异下可能是不稳定的,而面具水平比较平均值则在连贯的区域内呈现出特征,从而减少局部噪音.

blocks.en: Fig. 12 further shows that HyperSAM better preserves the shapes of changed regions than HyperFree and avoids the heavy fragmentation observed in some pixel-level or weakly adapted baselines. The two-directional mask comparison also matters. Masks generated from the first date may better describe pre-change objects, while masks generated from the second date may better describe newly emerged or disappeared structures. Taking the maximum of both directional responses provides a simple way to reuse the same promptable interface for temporal reasoning without introducing a separate change-detection head.
blocks.zh: 图12进一步显示,HyperSAM比HyperFree更好地保存了变化区域形状,避免了在某些像素水平或弱适应基线中观察到的重碎裂. 双向面罩比较也很重要. 从第一个日期产生的面具可以更好地描述更改前的物体,而从第二个日期产生的面具可以更好地描述新出现的或消失的结构. 最大限度地使用两个方向性反应,提供了一个简单的方法,在不引入单独的变化检测头的情况下,再利用同一快速界面进行时间推理.

blocks.en: Fig. 12: Qualitative comparison on the Hermiston change detection scene [ 40 ] . HyperSAM produces more complete changed regions and fewer fragmented artifacts than the compared foundation-model baselines.
blocks.zh: 费格。 12:赫尔米斯顿变换探测场景定性比较[40]. HyperSAM生产更完整的变化区域,与比较的基础模型基线相比,零碎的文物更少.

blocks.en: IV-E Hyperspectral Target Detection
blocks.zh: IV-E 超光谱 目标检测

blocks.en: IV-E 1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: IV-E 1 实验设置

blocks.en: HTD is evaluated on the Nuance Cri scene [ 41 ] and the Airport scene from the Airport-Beach-Urban benchmark [ 38 ] . Each test scene provides one target spectrum or one target support prompt. When a target spectrum is available, the spectrum is first matched with the normalized hyperspectral cube by cosine similarity, and the highest-response location is used as a target support point. HyperSAM then generates candidate masks using 32 point prompts per side, predicted-IoU threshold 0.3, stability threshold 0.4, and box NMS threshold 0.7. The generated mask containing the support point is used to compute a region-level target prototype from dense embeddings. All candidate masks are scored by cosine similarity to this target prototype. Fixed cosine thresholds of 0.73 for Cri and 0.61 for Airport are then applied, followed by spatial dilation with a 3 × 3 3\times 3 kernel to produce the final detection maps.
blocks.zh: HTD在Nuance Cri场景[41]和机场场景从Airport-Beach-Urban基准[38]上评价. 每个测试场景都提供一个目标频谱或一个目标支持即时. 当有目标谱时,该谱首先通过余弦相似度与常态的超光谱立方体配对,最高响应位置作为目标支持点. HyperSAM然后使用每边32点的提示,预测-IoU阈值0.3,稳定性阈值0.4和框NMS阈值0.7生成候选口罩. 所生成的包含支持点的面具用于从密集嵌入物中计算一个区域级目标原型. 所有候选口罩都通过与这个目标原型的余弦相似性来打分. 然后对Cri和机场分别适用0.73和0.61的固定余弦阈值,然后用一个3×3 3\times 3内核进行空间拓扑,生成最终的探测地图.

blocks.en: IV-E 2 Results and Analyses
blocks.zh: 四-E 2 结果和分析

blocks.en: On Cri, specialized spectral detectors are extremely strong, and TSTTD [ 51 ] achieves the best DF and ODP. HyperSAM remains competitive, with DF close to classical ACE [ 49 ] and MF [ 5 ] . This is a useful negative case for a unified model: when the target is almost perfectly defined by a distinctive spectrum and little spatial ambiguity exists, a carefully designed spectral detector can still be preferable. HyperSAM should therefore be interpreted as a transferable promptable model rather than a replacement for every specialized detector in every sensing condition.
blocks.zh: 在Cri上,专用光谱探测器极强,TSTTD[51]达到了最好的DF和ODP. HyperSAM仍然具有竞争力,DF接近古典ACE[49]和MF[5]. 对于一个统一的模型来说,这是一个有用的负面案例:当目标被一个独特的光谱几乎完美地定义,空间模糊度也很小时,精心设计的光谱探测器仍然比较可取. 因此,HyperSAM应被解释为一种可转移的快速模型,而不是在每一种感知状态下替代每一个专门探测器。

blocks.en: On Airport, where spatial context and object-level grouping are more important, HyperSAM achieves the best DF and ODP, outperforming HyperFree [ 7 ] , HyperSIGMA [ 6 ] , and DOFA [ 12 ] . The visual results in Fig. 13 and Fig. 14 clarify this behavior. In the compact Cri scene, purely spectral matching is already highly effective, while HyperSAM still produces target-focused responses with limited background activation. In the more structured Airport scene, region-level mask features help suppress clutter and aggregate target evidence over object-like areas. This task-dependent behavior strengthens the cross-task message: the benefit of promptable spectral-spatial modeling is largest when spectral evidence and object grouping are complementary.
blocks.zh: 在机场,空间背景和物体级别分组更为重要,HyperSAM实现最佳DF和ODP,表现优于HyperFree [7],HyperSIGMA [6],DOFA [12]. 图13和图14的视觉结果澄清了这种行为. 在紧凑的Cri场景中,纯光谱匹配已经非常有效,而HyperSAM仍然产生目标焦点响应,背景激活有限. 在结构更严谨的机场场景中,区域一级的面具特征有助于压制类似物体的区域的杂乱无章和集合目标证据。 这种依赖于任务的行为强化了跨任务信息:当光谱证据和对象分组互补时,快速光谱-空间模型化的好处最大.

blocks.en: Fig. 13: Qualitative comparison on the Nuance Cri target detection scene [ 41 ] . HyperSAM remains competitive with strong spectral detectors while producing region-consistent target responses.
blocks.zh: 图13:Nuance Cri目标探测场景定性比较[41]. HyperSAM仍然具有强大的光谱探测器的竞争力,同时产生与区域一致的目标响应.

blocks.en: Fig. 14: Qualitative comparison on the Airport target detection scene from the Airport-Beach-Urban benchmark [ 38 ] . HyperSAM benefits from object-level mask features and achieves stronger clutter suppression than several spectral or foundation-model baselines. The false-color composite uses the closest available bands to 700, 546.1, and 438.8 nm as red, green, and blue, respectively.
blocks.zh: 费格。 14:机场目标探测场景从机场-沥青-城市基准进行定性比较[38]. HyperSAM从物体级遮罩特征中获益,比几个光谱或基建模型基线实现更强的整齐压制. 假彩色复合材料分别使用700,546.1和438.8nm最接近的可用波段作为红色,绿色和蓝色.

blocks.en: IV-F Ablation Studies and Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-F 关系研究与进一步分析

blocks.en: IV-F 1 Data Construction, Architecture Components, and MoE Refinement
blocks.zh: IV-F 1 数据建设、建筑构件和教育部

blocks.en: Table III explicitly separates the training corpus, frozen RGB prior, hyperspectral side encoder, MoE refinement, and confidence-aware weighting. The HyperFree-data setting follows the larger but less object-centric Hyper-Seg corpus [ 7 ] , whereas the synthetic-HSI settings use the physically constrained SpaceNet-derived corpus. The comparison shows that sample count alone is not sufficient for promptable hyperspectral learning: spectral plausibility, spatial sharpness, semantic diversity, and pseudo-mask reliability are especially important because mask supervision depends on object boundaries and region consistency. Raw multispectral input remains competitive on PaviaU HC, indicating that directly observed bands can capture scene-specific land-cover cues, whereas the synthesized full spectrum is more useful when material shape and target/background separability are central.
blocks.zh: 表三明确区分培训内容、RGB前冷冻、超光谱侧编码器、MOE改进和信心感应权重。 HyperFree-data 设置遵循更大但不太以对象为中心的Hyper-Segual [7],而合成-HSI设置则使用物理受限的SpaceNet-衍生物. 比较显示,单凭样本数不足以进行迅速的超光谱学习:光谱的可信度,空间的锐度,语义的多样性,以及伪面具的可靠性特别重要,因为面具监督依赖于对象边界和区域的一致性. 原始的多光谱输入在PaviaU HC上仍然具有竞争力,表明直接观测到的波段可以捕捉到场景特有的陆地覆盖提示,而当物质形状和靶场/背景可分离性处于中心位置时,合成的全谱更有用.

blocks.en: The removal experiments further show that the two branches are complementary. Removing the frozen RGB branch weakens the inherited objectness, boundary, and prompt-response priors, while removing the hyperspectral side encoder eliminates material-sensitive full-spectrum corrections. The MoE path improves scale-adaptive mask refinement, and confidence-aware weighting increases robustness to structured pseudo-label noise. Thus, these components address distinct parts of the adaptation problem rather than duplicating the same function.
blocks.zh: 移除实验进一步表明,这两个分支是互补的. 删除被冻结的RGB分支会削弱继承的对象,边界,以及即时反应前缀,同时去除超光谱侧编码器会消除对材料敏感的全谱校正. MOE路径改进了规模适应性面具的精度,信心感的权重提升到结构化的伪标签噪声. 因此,这些组成部分涉及适应问题的不同部分,而不是重复同一功能。

blocks.en: TABLE III: Component-wise ablation of HyperSAM. Components are grouped into training data, network structure, and confidence-aware training.
blocks.zh: 表三:HyperSAM的组件偏振。 构成部分分为培训数据、网络结构和信心培训。

blocks.en: Table IV isolates the prior-preserving initialization while holding the data, frozen RGB branch, side encoder, MoE path, optimization, and evaluation protocol fixed. Randomly initialized injection modules can perturb the pretrained RGB features at the beginning of training. Zero initialization instead begins with zero residual injection, so the network initially reproduces the frozen SAM3 representation and introduces hyperspectral corrections gradually. The consistent improvement supports this stable adaptation strategy.
blocks.zh: 表四在保存数据时隔离前置保留初始化,冻结RGB分支,侧编码器,MOE路径,优化,和评价协议固定. 随机初始化的注射模块可以在训练开始时扰动预先训练的RGB特性. 零初始化转而从零余注射开始,因此网络最初复制冷冻的SAM3代表,并逐渐引入超光谱校正. 持续的改进支持这一稳定的适应战略。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Ablation of the feature-injection initialization strategy. All other settings are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 表格 四,制定特征注入初始化战略. 其他所有设置都保持不变。

blocks.en: We also conduct a controlled leave-one-term-out ablation of the reconstruction objective in Eq. ( 4 ). Every variant uses the same paired spectral library, SpaceNet patches, initialization, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, and number of iterations. Only the indicated term is removed. The same HyperSAM configuration is then trained on each resulting corpus and evaluated with unchanged downstream protocols. As shown in Table V , the complete objective achieves the best overall transfer. Removing L 1 L_{1} weakens radiometric fidelity, removing L cos L_{\cos} reduces spectral-shape consistency, removing L proj L_{\mathrm{proj}} weakens agreement with the observed WorldView-3 signal, removing L sp L_{\mathrm{sp}} produces less parsimonious material mixtures, and removing L tv L_{\mathrm{tv}} reduces spatial coherence in abundance and illumination maps. The results indicate complementary rather than redundant constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们还对Eq.(4)的重建目标进行有控制的一次性休假。 每个变体都使用相同的配对光谱库,SpaceNet补丁,初始化,优化器,学习率表,以及迭代次数. 只删除所指明的术语。 同样的HyperSAM配置随后就每个生成体进行培训,并用不变的下游协议进行评估。 如表五所示,完全目标实现了最佳的总体转移。 删除L 1 L_{1} 削弱辐射精度,去掉L cos L_{\cos} 降低光谱形状的一致性,去掉L proj L_{\mathrm{proj}} 弱化与观测到的世界View-3信号的一致,去掉L sp L_{\mathrm{sp}} 产生较少的异质物质混合物,去掉Ltv L_{\mathrm{tv}}} 降低丰度和照明图的空间一致性. 结果显示了补充性而不是多余的限制因素。

blocks.en: TABLE V: Leave-one-term-out ablation of the hyperspectral data-generation objective. All variants use the same training data, initialization, and optimization schedule.
blocks.zh: 表五:超光谱数据生成目标的一期停用。 所有变体都使用相同的训练数据,初始化,优化时间表.

blocks.en: The MoE routing statistics in Fig. 15 provide a direct interpretation of the refiner. Expert 3 is selected for 45.2% of masks containing 1–64 pixels but only 18.2% of masks larger than 1024 pixels, whereas Expert 1 increases from 4.5% for the smallest masks to 36.4% for the largest. Expert 2 remains active across all ranges, with routing frequencies from 45.5% to 50.3%. This soft division of labor indicates that Expert 3 specializes more strongly in small-object refinement, Expert 1 becomes increasingly important for large regions, and Expert 2 captures scale-shared patterns without expert collapse.

blocks.en: Fig. 16 compares HyperSAM with and without the CromSS-style confidence-aware robust learning [ 22 ] . The robust version improves the main HC result on PaviaU, the HCD results on both BayArea/River and Hermiston, and the HAD ODP scores. This confirms that pseudo-mask supervision benefits from selecting reliable regions and softly down-weighting uncertain boundaries, holes, and ambiguous background leakage. The result also clarifies a common issue in hyperspectral foundation-model training: pseudo-masks are not uniformly wrong or uniformly correct. Interior regions of roads, buildings, water, or vegetation often provide useful supervision, whereas thin boundaries, shadows, mixed pixels, and small objects introduce structured label noise. Treating these two cases differently is more appropriate than discarding pseudo-masks altogether.

blocks.en: The HTD results are more mixed, especially on Airport, which indicates that target detection is sensitive to prototype selection, score calibration, and thresholding. Thus, confidence-aware weighting mainly improves the reliability of mask representation learning rather than replacing task-specific detection calibration. To illustrate this mechanism, Fig. 8 visualizes the learned confidence weight map ( W W ). As shown in the figure, the network successfully assigns higher weights to structurally clear and reliable semantic regions. In contrast, ambiguous object boundaries and complex background fragments receive significantly lower weights. This qualitative observation directly validates our robust learning design: it prevents the model from blindly fitting noisy pseudo-labels at object borders while preserving the promptable foundation-model priors inherited from the frozen RGB branch.

blocks.en: IV-F 3 Cross-Task Summary
blocks.zh: IV-F 3 交叉任务摘要

blocks.en: The experiments show that HyperSAM is strongest when object-level grouping and spectral-spatial features are both useful. HC and HCD benefit from mask-level features because they require coherent region interpretation rather than isolated pixel decisions. HAD benefits from dense promptable proposals because small coherent anomalies can be separated from large background regions. HTD is more scene-dependent: classical spectral detectors such as ACE, MF, GLRT, and TSTTD [ 49 , 5 , 50 , 51 ] can dominate when the target is defined almost perfectly by its spectrum, whereas HyperSAM is advantageous when spatial context and object grouping help suppress clutter.
blocks.zh: 实验显示,当物体级组和光谱空间特征都有用时,HyperSAM最强. HC和HCD得益于面具级特征,因为它们需要连贯的区域解释而不是孤立的像素决定. 大量迅速的建议使这些提议受益匪浅,因为小的一致异常现象可以从大背景区域中分离出来。 HTD更依赖场景:古典光谱探测器,如ACE,MF,GLRT,以及TSTTD[49,5,50,51],当目标几乎被其光谱完美地定义时,可以主导,而HyperSAM则在空间上下文和物体分组帮助压制杂乱时是有利的.

blocks.en: The expanded ablations provide the same message from another angle. Improvements in HC, HAD, and HCD generally track the quality of abundance-transfer data construction, prior-preserving spectral adaptation, MoE mask refinement, and confidence-aware learning, whereas HTD is more sensitive to the target prototype, score calibration, and thresholding. The most transferable parts of HyperSAM are therefore the spectral-mask corpus, frozen-prior adaptation, and robust mask representation, while specialized detection can still benefit from task-aware calibration. Within the evaluated one-shot, zero-shot, and small-scene protocols, these results support HyperSAM as a unified promptable spectral-spatial model rather than a collection of task-specific networks.
blocks.zh: 扩展的音符从另一个角度提供相同的信息. HC、HAD和HCD的改进一般跟踪丰度转移数据构造的质量、预先保存光谱调整、MOE面具改进和信心意识学习,而HTD对目标原型、分数校准和阈值更敏感。 因此,HyperSAM中最可转让的部分是光谱扫描仪、冷冻前置和坚固的面具表示,而专门检测仍可从任务感应校准中受益。 在被评价的一发,零发,小场协议中,这些结果支持HyperSAM作为统一的可快速光谱空间模型,而不是任务特定网络的集合.

blocks.en: The current study also has important limitations. HyperSAM is trained exclusively on synthesized hyperspectral data, and measured endmembers plus multispectral reconstruction constraints cannot reproduce the full variability of real acquisitions. Differences in sensor response, atmosphere, spatial resolution, geography, season, illumination, and land-cover distribution introduce a synthetic-to-real domain gap. SAM3-derived pseudo-masks can disagree with hyperspectral material boundaries, particularly around shadows, thin structures, mixed pixels, and spectrally distinct but visually similar surfaces. The method also depends on the availability and stability of the specific original SAM3 checkpoint used here. Finally, the present benchmarks emphasize frozen-checkpoint, one-shot, zero-shot, or small-scene inference. They do not establish superiority under large-patch training or full downstream fine-tuning, and specialized spectral detectors can remain preferable when a target is almost completely defined by its spectrum. Future work should combine diverse real annotated HSI with the synthetic corpus, broaden sensor and material coverage, and evaluate large-patch and full-fine-tuning regimes.
blocks.zh: 目前的研究也有重要的局限性。 HyperSAM只接受合成的超光谱数据培训,所测量的终端成员加上多光谱重建限制无法复制真实获取的全部变异性. 传感器响应,大气,空间分辨率,地理,季节,照明,以及土地覆盖分布等方面的差异,都引入了合成-现实域间隙. blocks.en: IV-G Real-World Applicability
blocks.zh: IV-G 现实世界的适用性

blocks.en: IV-G 1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: IV-G 1 实验设置

blocks.en: We further evaluate HyperSAM on the HOSD Gulf of Mexico GM13/GM17 scenes [ 42 ] . The experiment is formulated as binary classification between oil spill and clean seawater. Oil-spill mapping is included because it stresses the necessity of hyperspectral sensing in a practical environmental-monitoring scenario: SAR and RGB observations can capture slick-like structures, but look-alike sea surfaces, illumination changes, and wave-related dark regions can make purely spatial or intensity-based cues ambiguous [ 53 ] . Dense hyperspectral measurements provide additional material-level evidence for separating oil-covered water from clean water and non-oil sea surfaces [ 42 ] . Each original 224-band AVIRIS cube is directly processed by the common HyperSAM spectral interface without task-specific fine-tuning. We randomly sample 50 labeled pixels from each class to construct the corresponding spectral-spatial prototypes, while all remaining pixels are used for evaluation. The trained checkpoint and automatic mask generation parameters remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价墨西哥湾HOSD GM13/GM17场景的HyperSAM [42]. 该实验被制定为漏油和清洁海水的二元分类. 将溢油测绘包括在内是因为它强调在实际环境监测情景中超光谱感知的必要性:合成孔径雷达和RGB观测可以捕捉类似浮油的结构,但类似外观的海面、光照变化和与波有关的暗区可以使纯粹的空间或强度提示模糊[53]。 Dense超光谱测量为将含油水与清洁水和非石油海面分开提供了额外的物质级证据[42]。 每个原224波段的AVIRIS立方体由通用的HyperSAM光谱接口直接处理,不进行任务特定的微调. 我们随机抽取每类50个标注的像素,以构建相应的光谱-空间原型,而其余的像素全部用于评价. 训练有素的检查站和自动面具生成参数保持不变。

blocks.en: IV-G 2 Results and Analyses
blocks.zh: 四-G 2 结果和分析

blocks.en: HyperSAM achieves an OA of 91.14% and an AA of 90.83% on HOSD-GM13, and an OA of 97.39% and an AA of 97.65% on HOSD-GM17. These results indicate that HyperSAM captures useful representations for both oil-covered and clean-water regions despite the substantial difference between these marine scenes and the urban synthetic imagery used during training. The experiment therefore provides a complementary form of validation: the model is not only competitive on standard HC/HAD/HCD/HTD benchmarks, but can also transfer its promptable spectral-spatial representation to an application where material discrimination is essential.
blocks.zh: HOSD-GM13上的OA为91.14%,AA为90.83%;HOSD-GM17上的OA为97.39%,AA为97.65%。 这些结果表明,尽管这些海洋场景与培训期间使用的城市合成图象之间存在很大差异,但HyperSAM对覆盖的石油区和净水区都有有用的表述。 因此,该实验提供了一种补充性的验证形式:该模型不仅在标准HC/HAD/HCD/HTD基准上具有竞争力,而且能够将其迅速的光谱空间表示转移到一种应用上,因为物质歧视是必不可少的。

blocks.zh: 图16:CromSS风格信心意识强健学习[22]. 比较报告HC、HAD、HCD和HTD的衡量标准是否具有噪音标签加权和交叉视图的一致性。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 17 , the predictions preserve large-scale oil-spill structures, although errors remain around fragmented slick boundaries and spectrally ambiguous transition regions. These failure cases are meaningful because they expose the remaining gap between synthetic urban training data and complex marine scenes. They also suggest a practical extension of the proposed data pipeline: if additional water, coastline, and oil-like spectral endmembers are incorporated, the same abundance-transfer strategy could synthesize more application-specific spectral-mask pairs for environmental monitoring without changing the HyperSAM architecture.
blocks.zh: 如图17所示,这些预测保留了大规模的溢油结构,尽管在零散的浮标边界和光谱模糊的过渡区域周围仍然有错误。 这些失败案例是有意义的,因为它们暴露了合成城市培训数据与复杂的海洋场景之间的剩余差距. 它们还建议实际扩大拟议的数据管道:如果纳入更多的水、海岸线和类似石油的光谱终端成员,同样的丰度转移战略可以合成更多针对应用的光谱掩码对,进行环境监测,而不改变HyperSAM结构。

In addition to predictive performance, we evaluate the operational cost of
deploying different hyperspectral classification pipelines under the same
one-shot Indian Pines protocol. Reporting energy and carbon cost alongside
accuracy has become increasingly important for large neural models and
foundation-model research [ 54 , 55 , 56 ] . The benchmark is designed to measure the

includes one-shot supervised training from random initialization followed by
full-scene inference. For HyperSIGMA-LP and DOFA-LP, it includes frozen
backbone feature extraction, one-shot linear-probe fitting, and full-scene
inference.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present HyperSAM , a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that integrates physics-informed data synthesis, SAM3-based spectral adaptation, and confidence-aware robust learning. By reconstructing full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from SpaceNet multispectral imagery and pairing them with high-resolution SAM3 pseudo-masks, HyperSAM builds object-centric spectral-mask supervision with sharp spatial boundaries and physically plausible spectra. Architecturally, it preserves the geometric and prompt-response priors of the frozen SAM3 RGB branch, injects hyperspectral evidence through a trainable side encoder with zero-initialized residual adapters, and uses a lightweight MoE decoder for scale-adaptive mask refinement. During training, best-mask supervision, CromSS-style confidence weighting, dual spectral-window consistency, and router balance regularization improve robustness to imperfect pseudo-masks. Experiments across HC, HAD, HCD, and HTD show that one trained HyperSAM parameter set can be reused under the evaluated small-scene protocols. The gains over SAM3 verify the value of spectral adaptation in this setting, while the comparisons with hyperspectral baselines demonstrate the benefit of preserving promptable foundation-model priors under a common low-label budget. Ablation results further show that a compact but higher-quality synthetic corpus can be more effective than a larger weakly object-centric corpus. Overall, HyperSAM suggests that reliable object masks, physically plausible spectra, and stable promptable priors are useful ingredients for transferable hyperspectral foundation models. The additional HOSD experiment further demonstrates transfer to airborne hyperspectral oil-spill mapping and environmental monitoring.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了HyperSAM, 一个快速的超光谱基础模型, 将物理学信息化的数据合成, 基于SAM3的光谱适应, 以及自信的强健学习结合起来。 通过从SpaceNet多光谱图象中重建全光谱超光谱立方体,并将其与高分辨率的SAM3伪磁片配对,HyperSAM用尖锐的空间界限和物理上可信的光谱构建了以物体为中心的光谱罩监督. 在建筑上,它保存了冷冻的SAM3 RGB分支的几何学和即时反应前身,通过带有零初始化残余适配器的可列车侧式编码器注入超光谱证据,并使用轻量级的MOE解码器进行规模适应性面具的改进. 在训练期间,最佳面具监督,CromSS风格的置信权重,双光谱窗一致性,路由器平衡规范化将稳健性提升到不完善的伪按摩. 跨越HC、HAD、HCD和HTD的实验表明,一个经过训练的HyperSAM参数集可以在评价的小场协议下重新使用。 相对于SAM3的增益核实了光谱适应在此环境下的价值,而与超光谱基线的比较表明,在共同的低标签预算下保留快速的基础模型前科是有好处的。 偏差结果进一步表明,一个紧凑但质量较高的合成体可能比一个更大的弱对象中心体更有效。 总体而言,HyperSAM认为,可靠的物体面具、物理上可信的光谱和稳定的快速前传是可转移的超光谱基础模型的有用成分。 额外的HOSD实验进一步证明了向空中超光谱溢油绘图和环境监测的转移。
